text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after completing her 
first three years in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the hot spring trip you won in 
the raffle—no, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: We're going on a school trip!
choice_data_list:
A-Are you seriously trying to mimic a 
school trip...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I already took care of the 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
All you need to bring with you, Trainer, 
is the excitement of a student on a school 
trip!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And on the day of the trip, I headed to 
the designated station.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, the school trip guide 
pamphlet!
choice_data_list:
An itinerary...! This really feels like a 
school trip!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the thin copied booklet handed to 
me. In addition to the itinerary and 
travel precautions, it even listed "room 
assignments" and "group activities."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I also put together a brief summary of 
info on the sightseeing spots. I left 
space for notes and thoughts too, so 
please feel free to use it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And remember, the travel rules must be 
strictly observed! Even if it's just the 
two of us, we act as a group!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, make sure you follow the rules 
properly too!
choice_data_list:
Got it. It really does feel like a school 
trip.

Got it. It really does feel like a school 
trip, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right? And I made sure the snacks for both 
of us stayed under 1,000 yen, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The guide and the snacks. These little 
touches really make it feel like a school 
trip— I'm getting seriously excited now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Our final stop is right here! The 
souvenir shop!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since it's a school trip, we have to 
buy souvenirs too. I wonder what would be 
good~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's find some local specialty from 
here... Ah! Look, it's a car-shaped 
kokeshi doll!
choice_data_list: Huh, that's unusual.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
They even have kokeshi dolls shaped like 
cars...! Hey, why don't we get this as a 
souvenir?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Traditional kokeshi colors are lovely too, 
but I definitely prefer this one!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Metallic coating!! What an innovative 
design!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! The texture of this bodywork... 
doesn't it look just like a classic car!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While shaped like a simple kokeshi doll, 
the paintwork was undeniably artistic. It 
bore a resemblance to the classic cars she 
adored.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
As for souvenirs, a kokeshi doll would 
be...—!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry. I almost bought it on pure 
impulse just now...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go with something more practical, 
or something consumable."
choice_data_list: No, let's go with the kokeshi doll!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On school trips, caught up in the moment, 
people always end up buying souvenirs 
they'd never normally get. ...Like wooden 
swords, for instance.
choice_data_list: Besides, you liked it, didn't you?
Besides, you liked it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, yes.
choice_data_list:
Then let's display it in the Trainer's 
Office.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Ehh? Are you serious?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well... looking at this to remember 
today's trip might not be so bad after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived at the inn~♪ Well then, I'll 
come by your room once I've changed.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, when you think of staying at an inn 
on a school trip, there's only one thing 
to do!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Yes, a pillow fight!
choice_data_list: In broad daylight?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Making noise at night would cause 
trouble for others. We also want to avoid 
breaking anything in the inn. So—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's have an air pillow fight!
choice_data_list: An air pillow fight!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Right. We just pretend to throw pillows 
and react as if we got hit. Simply put, 
it's a voice-only pillow fight!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this even a pillow fight anymore? 
Still, I'd rather not cause trouble for 
the inn.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! This is acting practice 
too, so make it realistic!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Heeeyah!
choice_data_list: Kuh... As if! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*whoosh*...! A graceful dodge! (Picks up 
pillow)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Daaaah!
choice_data_list: Oof! —Waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...I won!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Impressive as always, 
Trainer-san. That was great acting! I got 
totally fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... This burns quite a few 
calories, doesn't it...?
choice_data_list:
*pant* *pant*... It was a fierce battle, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that was quite the realistic 
performance. Even your facial expression 
looked completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, that sent a tingle through me, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we wash off this sweat 
before dinner...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it's a hot spring after all. It 
really would be a waste just to take a 
quick dip, wouldn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I enjoyed taking my time with it.

Yeah. I took my time and really savored 
it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It might not feel like a real school trip, 
but... Care for some coffee milk?
choice_data_list: Let's drink!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is definitely a special perk of 
our mock school trip♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Dinner was delicious, wasn't it! In 
particular, the seasoning of the seasoned 
rice was just exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over dinner, conversation flowed easily as 
we looked back on today's itinerary. 
Afterward, we returned to our room to 
relax...
choice_data_list:
It really felt like a school trip, it was 
so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not over yet, is it? The best 
part of the school trip is still to come!
choice_data_list: "The greatest fun"...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to nights on a school trip, 
of course, it's gotta be—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: L-O-V-E talk♡
choice_data_list:
(She never learns... No, she just never 
gives up, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though trying to strike up a 
conversation with BNW during summer camp 
ended in total disaster.
choice_data_list: …You want to hear it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Love talk... Are you sure you really want 
to hear it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: U-Um, w-well......

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Never mind, I don't need it after all!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I kind of feel like asking, but... If I 
ask, somehow... somehow...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'd probably get all fidgety and shy, so 
I'll pass...!
choice_data_list: Ahaha. What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Geez, you had no intention of telling me 
from the start! You're so mean, Trainer...
choice_data_list:
I was trying to hype things up like it's a 
school trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she had prepared so much and set 
everything up to feel just like a real 
school trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told them that I truly enjoyed today, 
and that reminiscing about student days 
made me want to explore the school trip 
experience to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Did you make memories on our school 
trip?
choice_data_list: Yeah. What an extraordinary memory!
Yeah. Unforgettable memories!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hearing those words is all the 
satisfaction I need!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Your youth might have shone so brightly 
that you still wish to relive it even now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Even though I won't be there...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Youth spent with me isn't half bad either, 
wouldn't you say?
choice_data_list: Royce...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, but? Memories with me are being spun 
in the present tense anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Though someday, I plan to overwrite any of 
your youthful nostalgia with memories of 
me being the "strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Be prepared!
choice_data_list: Haha, gladly!
Fufu, with pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Royce and Royce...
